title: KTP Adjudication Token
description: The payload of an adjudication token: the normative rail's answer to a declared gate, bound by digest to exactly what it adjudicated. The token is carried as a JWS whose signature covers this whole payload; the signing key is identified by kid under the issuer. JSON Schema checks shape only. It does not verify the signature, the digests against the ingress session, the grant, the evidence or the topology, or that the issuer is the declared external schema's party; those are the receiving gateway's checks under KTP-CORE L11. A token that fails any of them is absent, never a denial.

iss.description: The adjudicating party: the issuer named by the declared external schema for norm content

kid.description: Identifier of the issuer's signing key that covers this payload

favorable.description: Whether the verdict satisfies the gate it answers. True satisfies that gate and nothing else; false does not. No other verdict semantics are carried

action_digest.description: Digest of the canonical action, whole, that was adjudicated. A different or decomposed action has a different digest and the token answers nothing for it

actor.description: The subject identifier of the actor adjudicated. The token answers nothing for any other actor

cnf_jkt.description: Thumbprint of the actor's proof-of-possession key, so the presenting party must hold the key the verdict was issued to

grant_digest.description: Digest of the grant in force when the verdict was issued. A new, widened or revoked grant changes it and voids the token

evidence_digest.description: Digest of the evidence the verdict judged. Corrected or new evidence changes it and voids the token

zone_id.description: Identifier of the zone in which the verdict was issued. The token is absent in any other zone

topology_epoch.description: The topology epoch in force when the verdict was issued. The token is absent after the topology changes

exp.description: Expires at (Unix timestamp). The token is void when now >= exp, including the boundary instant
